The Democratic Party didn’t immediately return Benzinga’s request for comment.
Caucus meetings typically precede major floor votes, but the result of Tuesday’s vote is still up in the air.
The key sticking point is an ethics requirement aimed at President
Donald Trump’s
family’s cryptocurrency dealings.
